chunks: We have sent you only as a bearer of good tidings and admonisher for all mankind; yet most people do not understand.
ai.seo_question: What is the universal role of the Prophet in Islam according to Surah Saba?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the universality of Prophet Muhammad’s (peace be upon him) mission, emphasizing that his role as both bearer of glad tidings and warner extends to all humanity, not just a specific tribe. The phrase 'most people do not know' is often interpreted to signify a lack of deep spiritual awareness or recognition of the Prophet’s true status, a theme resonating with the Shia emphasis on the need for guided understanding (ma'rifah) of divine messengers.
